'''Cedonia Teraan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was a member of [[House Teraan]] and the Herald of the Gold Aurora during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
During the time of the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Cedonia and her brother [[Lenn Teraan]] became the only remaining members of the [[House Teraan]] when it was devastated during a clash with [[House Baliss]] leading to them relocating to safety with [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]]. Their ancestral estate was taken over by House Baliss during this time.<ref name="PiF" />

In [[3643 BBY]], Cedonia and Lenn Teraan tasked a [[Voidhound|smuggler]] to infiltrate their former estate in order to recover data from their homes library on how to unlock the antique [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that held the key to restoring their family. Once unlocked, the droid revealed that numerous other families owed House Teraan [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and both siblings departed to meet with the Royal Council in order to verify the data.<ref name="PiF" />

The Teraans later called the Voidhound for help once more, when House Baliss discovered the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler's]] intrusion and had sent [[Xin Baliss]] to challenge Lenn to a duel to the death. Thankfully for the Teraans, the smuggler agreed to fight Xin and managed to kill the supposedly unbeatable duelist. Though impressed by the smuggler's skill, the Teraans then chose to depart [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] before House Baliss attempted more attacks on their life.<ref name="TD">{{TORcite|type=class|[[Voidhound|Smuggler]]|The Duel|[[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Cedonia Teraan can be romanced by a male Smuggler player character.<ref name="TD" />
